verdict.rationale: While Fenwick documents deep domestic VC/startup practice (1,500+ VC-backed clients) and international trademark registration in 180+ jurisdictions, there is no evidence addressing cross-border venture-specific work such as international investor structuring, corporate flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings. The offices page explicitly lists only seven US locations with no international offices, and no practice page or resource mentions cross-border financing structures.
